howItWorks.title: Effortless purchase tracking in 3 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No manual spreadsheets, no forgotten dates, and zero access to your store passwords.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Link your Gmail or Outlook with one-click read-only OAuth, or simply forward order confirmations to your private receipts address.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our intelligent parsing engine identifies the retailer, extracts purchased items, totals, and automatically calculates strict return and warranty deadlines.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Receive gentle reminders 7, 3, and 1 day before return windows close, complete with pre-filled claim templates if you need a return or refund.

features.title: Engineered for peace of mind
features.subtitle: Everything you need to safeguard your hard-earned money across every online checkout.
features.f1Desc: Visual deadline countdowns for every store policy—30 days, 60 days, holiday extended returns, and custom merchant rules.
features.f2Desc: Keep track of standard 1-year manufacturer warranties and extended plans before costly equipment fails.
features.f3Desc: Store invoices, PDF receipts, and package tracking links securely in one cloud-encrypted vault.
features.f4Desc: Generate professional, merchant-ready return and warranty request emails with proof of purchase attached.

pricing.plusDesc: For frequent online buyers and households.
pricing.annualDesc: Best value for power shoppers (2 months free).
pricing.guaranteeNote: 14-day money-back guarantee for your PurchaseGuard subscription. Does not apply to third-party merchant refunds.

security.title: Security & privacy at our core
security.subtitle: We never sell your data, scrape merchant sites, or ask for your store passwords.
security.sec1Desc: We strictly use OAuth 2.0 with minimal read-only scopes. We never see or store your email passwords.
security.sec2Desc: We never log into your Amazon, Walmart, or merchant accounts. Your account credentials remain solely yours.
security.sec3Desc: All OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. All traffic is enforced with TLS 1.3.
security.sec4Desc: Export your entire history or delete your account and all associated records with one click under GDPR & CCPA.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does PurchaseGuard guarantee I get a refund from the store?
faq.a1: No. PurchaseGuard helps you track your purchases, monitor return deadlines, and prepare return requests. Retailers, carriers, and manufacturers always make the final decisions based on their return policies.
faq.q2: Do you need my Amazon or store passwords?
faq.a2: Never. PurchaseGuard never asks for your store passwords and does not scrape retailer websites. We only read order receipts either forwarded by you or via read-only Gmail/Outlook OAuth with your explicit permission.
faq.a3: When an order confirmation is parsed, PurchaseGuard identifies the store return policy (e.g. 30 days) and sends you alerts 7 days, 3 days, and 1 day before the window closes so you never miss a return window.
faq.q4: Can I delete my data at any time?
faq.a4: Yes. You have full control. You can disconnect your email, export your purchases as JSON/CSV, or permanently delete your account and all synced data instantly.
faq.a5: If you are not satisfied with your PurchaseGuard Plus or Annual subscription, you can request a full refund within 14 days of purchase. Note that this guarantee applies solely to the PurchaseGuard software subscription, not third-party retailer purchases.
